notes.title: Resume game after final boss
notes.notes:
Added the choice to resume the game after final boss fight, to continue the run for unfinished missions.
Also, added two new Achievements for bad endings.

notes.title: Game Launch next week
notes.notes:
We are excited about the game launch next week. Looking forward to that, we've updated the free-to-play demo with improved gameplay and layout.
We worked hard to create a strategy/role-playing game with captivating characters with background stories, while remaining the main focus on the strategy and a skill system which is hopefully a good balance between fascinating different builds to form your team and easy enough to start quickly into the game.
While you have mostly free rein in choosing from more available missions than you can finish in one run, there will be events triggered from time to time that will hopefully engage you into the story and defend the earth.
While we are running our last game tests, we hope you will have a good time testing the Demo.

Also, we added new trailers to the store page.
